title: Teaching Methodology - DSSSB TGT Computer Science

sections.name: DSSSB TGT Computer Science - Teaching Methodology Previous Year Questions

questions.q: Which of the following is a prime factor that helps decide the teaching method employed by a teacher in the classroom?
Which method of teaching is also known as 'Heuristic method'?
Which of the following is an example of 'descriptive' teaching, in which input is directly provided by the teacher?
The given examples come under different approaches to learning. Associate them properly. (a) Lecture method, (b) Whole group discussion, (c) Small group discussion, (d) Simulations, (e) Projects
options: (a) and (b) -- student centered; (c), (d) and (e) -- teacher centered
(a) and (b) -- teacher centered; (c), (d) and (e) -- student centered
(a), (b) and (c) -- teacher centered; (d) and (e) -- student centered

questions.q: Which of the following are commonly identified skills in the teaching-learning process? I. Skill in putting question II. Skill in introducing the topic III. Skill in non-verbal cues IV. Skill in explanation

Collaborative group work is important for enhancing pupil participation. Which of the following are key features of effective group work discussions? I. Pupils asking question II. Pupils actively and persistently seeking help from peers

As a teacher, which of the following techniques you can adopt in the classroom/school to use imitation for enabling young students to acquire positive and socially desirable behaviour? I. When any student imitates positive behaviour, try to recognize it and provide verbal praise encouraging him/her to repeat it. II. While teaching history and social science to students, always highlight the positive aspects of the important characters for imitation by the students.

'Internal organs, three dimensional geometric figures are best understood with models'. A teacher uses various learning materials to create an inclusive classroom. The given statement represents which of the following learning material?
options: Tactual materials in the form of real objects
Visual materials in the form of pictures or photographs

questions.q: Which of the following statement is NOT correct? I. Gender discrimination can be direct and indirect. II. Gender discrimination can be blatant or subtle.
Broadly, motor skills are classified into locomotor and manipulative skills. Which of the following activities are included in locomotor skills? I. Climbing II. Running III. Walking
Which of the following is NOT a step of the Herbartian model?
Which teaching approach prioritises learner autonomy and decision-making during the learning process?
Which of the following is a key aspect of subject pedagogy planning in education?
options: Aligning lesson plans with curriculum standards while incorporating strategies that
Using a single teaching method for all topics

Which of the following are the usefulness of competency based approach in teaching-learning process? I. It keeps the learner away from rote memorization.
Demonstration method of teaching is a ______.

Which of the following is/are the characteristics of an effective method of teaching and learning? I. Matches the mental ability and needs of the students II. Develops critical thinking of the children III. Provides a scope for development of life skills in children
What is the role of a teacher in Problem Solving method of teaching-learning process?
options: To act as a facilitator and guide
